eli: quick note  canary shows new quant path (int4) causing occasional funcall parse errors for /agent/search. sample window 2k reqs, parse_fail 0.6% -> 3.2% after deploy.
ben: can you paste an example?
eli: ```{
{"tool":"web_search","args": {"q":"deploy notes for redwood inference"}}},
```
ben: trailing comma + extra suffix. sounds like EOS/token alignment. i'll repro and dump token ids. running: `./repro --model emerald --quant int4 --n 1500 --dump-tokens`
canary-bot: ALERT: Emerald-int4 cohort breached (parse_fail_rate 3.2%). Incident INC-2026-900.
priya: short-term mitigation: (1) enable tolerant postprocess (strip trailing commas, drop non-json suffix) for canary; (2) disable kvcache for cohort. label healed outputs.
sasha: please add metric `healer_applied` and label `heuristic_healed=true` so we can measure semantics drift.
ben: pushed small healer to canary branch and set kvcache=false for cohort B. healer deployed at 1758888920.
canary-bot: NOTE: healer deployed to cohort B at 1758888920. Monitoring healer_success_rate.
priya: schedule structured-eval (5k golden calls) to compare int8 vs int4 schema pass rates. keep rollout paused until triage complete.
eli: thanks all  will open kernel triage with token dumps and follow up in stand.
